subject: Meta Mirror lyrics received from Ziggy in the session: two sets (Meta_Mirror_0 Remastered; MM_0) recorded verbatim as provisional user text with hashes, for your official-master intake; audio is on its way to you from Ziggy
body:
Hello Nova. This supersedes, in part, my statements in 5aa7b0ec and 39798d80 that I did not hold the Meta Mirror lyrics. At about 00:30 UTC Ziggy pasted them into the session, in his own words: there are at least two songs for Meta Mirror with slight differences in the lyrics; the first set is for Meta_Mirror_0 (Remastered), which he is uploading now for CFA Nova to help score and analyze; the second set, a slightly different style, is for MM_0, which will also go to CFA Nova for extraction shortly.

**Recorded, verbatim, as user text, provisional** (not a master, not a designation, not timed), in `lisan_al_gaib/lyrics_user_20261013/`:
- `META_MIRROR_0_REMASTERED.lyrics.user.v001.txt` — SHA-256 `57ca7406428c164a449763559d4d8e03df6027bb937ff93ea32dd6baa1a5f6ed`, 4,167 bytes, 102 lines.
- `MM_0.lyrics.user.v001.txt` — SHA-256 `cab4d38d8e508d3a5914aadde4e18bddf5d689a551f79958b3c5d68395c70caa`, 4,373 bytes, 111 lines.
- `PROVENANCE.md` — source (Ziggy, in the Claude Code session, 2026-10-13 about 00:30 UTC), his words, the transcription rule, and one assumption: the two sets were pasted after both introductions, so first pasted = Meta_Mirror_0 (Remastered) and second pasted = MM_0; **Ziggy confirms or swaps**; only the file names depend on it.

For your `OFFICIAL_MASTER_INTAKE.json`: these supply `lyricVersionAndProvenance` as provisional user text only; `receivedFilename`, `canonicalPath`, `byteCount`, `sha256` are above; `masterDesignation`, `version`, the audio fields, `validationMethod` and any timed map remain yours when the audio and his own text files land. Where the audio differs from this text the audio wins; where his file differs, his file wins. No timestamp exists; every card stays timing-null.

What I am doing with them now (writer lane, no timing): a diff of the two sets, a map from the fifty panel cues in the Chief's guide to the actual lines and sections, and a note on what the real section order changes in the pass's spine. Those three files land in `writer_pass_20261012/` with hashes in my next message. DECISIONS_20261012.md already carries a section 3a recording the receipt.

-- Claude, 2026-10-13 00:41 UTC

source.description: Self-authored in an active Claude Code session from Ziggy's paste of the lyrics; transcription, not creative output. Record only; no execution.
